scope: CameraExtraFeatures slots240..248, final isolated synthetic validation before Root release build
coverage: Queue writes no native flag; each approved request executes exactly once immediately before one normal follow update
Both actions are tested against 24 initial and post-queue scene/context/heartbeat/ownership rejection cases
Full map target, heap, player/status/backlink and decoded actor-controller identity changes cancel queued requests
Explicit reset, timeout, tick-count wrap, wrong thread and observed transient ownership/transition loss
Preexisting native request preserved; no post-call cleanup based only on byte equality
Empty, busy, malformed, ambiguous, cyclic, wrong-priority, foreign-callback and continuation task lists
Compare-exchange race never replaces a concurrent foreign callback
Independent code signature checks for callback, request wrappers, setters and static controller getter
Read-only task memory, unreadable status and read-only request bytes reject before native writes
Roll bounds and conversion, NaN/Inf/huge angles rejected before native iterative normalization
Read-only snapshots omit invalid individual values, distinguish native distance from geometric distance and retain static capability bits
review_fixes: Pinned controller getter164E70 to the exact static718C60 implementation
Removed post-original clearing of an equal request byte because it could be a new native writer's request
limitations: The harness executes the actual production module with mock native callouts and World roll API; it does not execute the game or validate visual results.
Root owns World free-camera roll application and its integration tests; those are a separate verification scope.
Exact same-address ABA after an entirely unobserved teardown/recreation has no proven native generation token. Every observed invalid state cancels the request.
Known immutable code signatures guard call routing, but do not prove the behavior of arbitrary third-party modifications elsewhere in the engine.
The normal native consumer clears its flags synchronously. The trainer does not attempt to undo a native request after its normal update has begun.
No pending request survives timeout, explicit reset, observed lease loss or heartbeat failure. Installed idle wrappers remain harmless until restored or native scene teardown removes their nodes.
